Title: Generally Available: TCP support for Azure Container Apps

Body.Content:
Azure Container Apps now supports using TCP-based protocols other than HTTP or HTTPS for ingress.

With this feature, you can now deploy Container Apps that communicate using TCP-based protocols on a specific port you set within the environment. Additionally, a container app can expose a TCP port externally for ingress when using a custom virtual network.

Learn more.
